stories.title: Pedestrians hit and critically injured by car at Thomaston Walmart
stories.summary: Three pedestrians were struck by a vehicle in a Thomaston Walmart parking lot, leaving two in critical condition, according to the town's police chief.

stories.title: Gov. Mills, property developers celebrate 25 new 'Opportunity Zones' to encourage investment in Maine’s rural communities
stories.summary: The federally-designated tax incentives are intended to attract investors to economically-distressed regions, including areas on Maine's main streets.

stories.title: Nonprofit to preserve Biddeford's history with a time capsule
stories.summary: Following a ceremony on Jan 7th, the time capsule will be on display at Biddeford City Hall for the next 50 years.

stories.title: NEWS CENTER Maine Weather Forecast
stories.summary: Low 60s continue Thursday and Friday afternoon. A bit cooler into the weekend with rain chances showing up late Sunday and Monday.

stories.title: OSHA proposes fining Robbins Lumber $54K for safety violations
stories.summary: OSHA has cited the mill for five serious safety violations after the Searsmont explosion that killed three people.

stories.title: Ellsworth Code Enforcement Office now requires appointments amid staff vacancy
stories.summary: The city announced Wednesday that, due to an empty position, all meetings are appointment-only and inspections must be scheduled two days in advance.

stories.title: Thanksgiving travel nears record highs as Maine gas prices climb
stories.summary: More than 3.6 million New Englanders are expected to travel for Thanksgiving, according to AAA, with drivers facing higher gas prices and heavy holiday traffic.

stories.title: Car crashes into Fairfield business, driver injured
stories.summary: A local boutique on Main Street in Fairfield sustained damage after a car crashed into its front porch, according to police. The driver has been arrested for an OUI.

stories.title: Maine joins push to block deal between nation's biggest vet suppliers
stories.summary: Maine and 12 other states joined the Federal Trade Commission in challenging Portland-based Covetrus' purchase of a rival, saying the deal could drive up costs.

stories.title: Farmington man charged with attempted murder, arson after Leeds house fire
stories.summary: The arrest follows an investigation into a fire reported Oct. 13 at 46 Jennings Road in Leeds, officials said.

stories.title: Maine rental assistance program sets deadline for new applications
stories.summary: The program provides rental assistance to eligible Maine households that have fallen behind on rent and are at risk of eviction.

stories.title: 3 dead after contracting respiratory viruses in Washington County
stories.summary: The Maine CDC has reported higher-than-expected cases of both flu and COVID-19 in Washington County.
